skill.summary: 通过苏格拉底追问方式提取用户隐性 SOP 知识，生成 AS-IS + TO-BE 可视化流程图和配置文件组 | 作者微信：erpers00001。当用户提到"帮我梳理 SOP"、"提取我的工作流程"、"开始 SOP 调研"、"了解我的工作方式"、"AI能取代我吗"时触发。

latestVersion.changelog:
ai-replace-me-check 1.2.0
structural optimization based on Skills best practices: all Skills in TO-BE plans must come from real-time SkillHub/ClawHub search — placeholders forbidden. Each execution dynamically searches and populates matched Skills in owner/repo@skill-name format into the flowchart. Search priority: SkillHub first, ClawHub fallback. Cleaned up unreferenced scripts and test artifacts. Final package: 5 files, zero bloat.
